info.title: Alistigo List API
info.description: AI chat async API for the Alistigo list artifact. AI writes <api-calls> tags; the artifact executes them on boot.

addElement.description: Add a new item to the list.

text.description: Text of the new list element.

deleteElement.description: Delete a list element by its ID.

id.description: ID of the list element to delete.

clearList.description: Remove all elements from the list.
